title: The left side fills
hook: Trace one part of the circulation.

knows: The heart has atria and ventricles.
doesNotKnow: Blood passes from the left atrium into the left ventricle through the mitral valve.

misconception: Blood passes randomly between the four chambers.
objective: Trace the specified step in normal mammalian circulation.

claims.text: Question, diagram and reveal: In normal circulation, blood leaving the left atrium passes into which chamber? Blood passes from the left atrium into the left ventricle through the mitral valve. The diagram is a simplified flow map, not the shape or scale of the heart and vessels.
